description: Post a follow-up message inside an existing forum post (thread). Requires the Send Messages in Threads permission (shown as 'Send Messages in Posts' for forums). Use discord_create_forum_post to start a new post instead. Returns the new message ID.

content.description: Plain-text body of the reply (max 2000 characters).

thread_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the forum post (thread) to reply in.

name: discord_reply_to_forum
